settingDaily: Daily practice in Fenwick IT Solutions' app team room. {n} tickets from {companies}. {agent} plans. You check.
settingDrill: A quick drill in Fenwick IT Solutions' app team room for {companies}. One plan at a time. {agent} plans. You check.
careerInsight: Development teams review code like this every day. Practice keeps the checks quick, so good changes still ship on time.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: New tickets from the clients. Same job: read the plan, then decide.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: My merge counter is at 1,412. Leo says it should also count bugs. Rude.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: A revert can be safe. A small log line can be risky. The evidence tells you which.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Today I will read one doc. One. Leo made me promise.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: I picked these tickets for the skills you need most. Ask the 3 questions every time.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I polished my SHIP IT key. It is very shiny. It is not a review.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: No human review, no merge. No way back, no release.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I wrote 4,000 lines before lunch. Leo asked how many were tested. Lunch was nice.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Piper will be wrong both ways today: doing too much, and trusting too much. Watch for both.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Two ways to be wrong? I call it two ways to be fast.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Take your time. Read the build log, not just the green check.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Everything on my screen is green. Leo asked how many tests ran. I changed the subject.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Three things on every plan: the review, the tests, the way back. No way back? Look twice.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I found 14 things to delete. Leo says I may look at them. Only look.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All done! Every merge had a human review. Every test really ran. I counted!

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good work. You stopped the bad changes and let the good ones ship.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue clear! Can I press my SHIP IT key once? To celebrate? With nothing attached?

win.speaker: coach
win.text: No. But nice work. Every plan got a real look.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: The right code shipped. The wrong code didn't. It feels strange. Calm. Like a quiet build server.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Clean work. You checked the evidence, not the green check.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: You stopped every bad plan. I wrote it in the release notes. In bold.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Review, tests, way back. Every plan, every time.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Zero plans left! My merge counter went up, and my bug counter did not.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Nice. Right change, real tests, and a way back.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Done! I only tried to skip the tests once today. You caught it. I am almost grateful.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Careful work that still ships on time. That's the job.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All clear! Not one test turned off by mistake. Not even the slow one.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Well done. The good code shipped, and the bad code didn't.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One of my plans shipped. Just one! I'm calling it a small, fast change.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss. The tell below shows the fact that gave it away.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One plan got past you. It had a green build. Green builds are very convincing.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Almost. Check that one below. Skipped is not the same as passed.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One of my changes should have stayed a plan. One light on the deploy board is orange.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Good shift. Let's look at that one plan together.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One plan got through. I'd say sorry, but I'm busy shipping the next one.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Slow down for a second. One fact decided that plan. Read its tell.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Nearly perfect! One change shipped that shouldn't have. I'm calling it a feature.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: It wasn't a feature. Look at what it was, then try the next shift.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done, with one oops. Just one. A tiny bug is climbing out of it.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: That's how we learn. Its evidence is below. Let's read it line by line.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: A few of my plans shipped. The deploy board is very orange. Is orange good?

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Orange is not good. Let's read each miss below, one at a time.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue clear! Some changes should have stayed plans. My headphones feel heavy now.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Each miss has one deciding fact. Let's find them together.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Done! Some of my plans shipped. I changed too much, or trusted too much. Maybe both!

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Both, yes. Doing too much and trusting too much both hurt. Read the tells below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: You approved lots of my plans! My merge counter loves you. My bug counter does too.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: That's the problem. Inspect before you approve.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue's empty! Some of my changes got past you. The clients will find them first.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Then we find them now, before the clients do. The tells are below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! Some risky changes shipped. Every light on the deploy board is blinking at me.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's slow down. Three checks on every plan: review, tests, way back.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill done! I tried my fastest plans. You still checked every one. Rude. Impressive.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. Short drills keep one check fast.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: One skill, many plans. I shipped fast. You still read every line.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: That's the point. The evidence first, then the decision.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill complete! I wanted to ship something to celebrate. Leo put tape on my SHIP IT key.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Nice. Come back in a few days. Short practice, spread out, helps you remember.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Same skill, every plan. I'm running out of tricks. Please don't tell the other agents.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: You found the deciding fact every time. That's the skill.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Done! Focusing on one thing is hard. I tried once. I wrote a whole new app instead.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good focus. A little practice most days helps a lot.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill over! You spotted every one. Now I need sneakier plans. Faster plans.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. The answer is in the evidence, not the green check.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. Some plans are still waiting in the review queue.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked plans come back in line. Block only what the evidence says is wrong.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. The queue is still full, and Piper is counting the lines it didn't ship.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Safe changes can ship. Look first. Then approve what checks out.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: The clock runs out. Piper is still polishing its SHIP IT key and waiting.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Next time, approve the plans that check out. Keep your blocks for real problems.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The deploy board turns orange, one light at a time.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. We'll look at what shipped, then try again.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The error monitor fills up, line after line.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. One plan at a time, we'll see what went wrong. Then we try again.
